adminBearer.x-purpose: averidi-dashboard-admin-v1 (bridge) or separately verified administrative OIDC access token

x-dashboard-integration.eventDirection: Dashboard to a future authorized receiver
x-dashboard-integration.eventAuthority: Informational only; never grants or changes another product subscription
receiverRequirements: atomically deduplicate eventId and semantic payload digest with receiver effect
reject changed payloads under the same eventId
reconcile current Dashboard-owned summaries; never order changes by timestamp alone
identityRequirements: stable issuer + subject, never email joins
no shared sessions, signing secrets or cookies
customer token requires explicit workspace allowlist and current Dashboard membership
read and manage administration grants remain independent
runtimeInvariants: active summaries require ACTIVE and a future currentPeriodEnd relative to checkedAt
inactive summaries expose no entitled plan
navigation links must match the response workspaceId exactly
signed event jti, workspace subject and envelope IDs must match
